title: Live improvement log
summary: Operator-ordered rolling log (2026-08-18): the orchestrator records improvement observations from live supervision over the coming hours. Every entry is reconciled against in-flight cards and existing dossiers before it may propose new work - dedup is the core discipline. Entries carry one of three verdicts: covered-by (existing key), operator-action (no ticket needed, a hand must move), or new-candidate (becomes a card only after a second sighting or operator nod). [Curated 2026-08-23: this is a rolling supervision log by design, not a single deliverable - it never reaches a terminal state, so it stays out of History structurally, not because of open work. Most of its own related task keys are already delivered (AGT-2648, AGT-2655, AGT-2658, AGT-2662, AGT-2672 archived); AGT-2663 and AGT-2664 remain in progress.]
